scope: Four full-detail hearing collection illustrations; exact generated hashes inspected.
globalConditions: Imagined present-day applications, no visible Christ and no documented private biography.
Pass is technical visual/source review, not owner approval or final browser acceptance.

entries.alt: An adult learner raises a hand beside an open notebook while the standing teacher looks toward him.
entries.caption: A raised hand interrupts the rush toward an easy answer. This imagined learning scene connects the sower's teaching about hearing and understanding with a practical habit: making room for a question. Listening can include admitting what we have not yet understood.
entries.findings: Raised hand has coherent fingers and wrist; teacher turns toward speaker, with natural book grip. Other learners attentive without repeated faces. Clear photographic skin, cloth and lighting.
conditions: Do not invent the question, subject of class or words on the notebook.

entries.alt: A woman looks toward a young person explaining a small bridge model, with her hand resting on a phone on the counter.
entries.caption: The conversation receives attention while the phone rests on the counter. This imagined scene offers an everyday reflection on Jesus' invitation to take care how we hear. Giving another person room to explain can help us receive what a distracted glance might miss.
entries.findings: Adult and youth faces and hands coherent. Youth points toward a plausible craft bridge while holding small craft piece. Adult looks at youth rather than phone. Phone screen appears dark; phone lies screen-up, not visibly face-down.
conditions: Do not say phone is face-down or that she has never been distracted.
Parent-child relationship may be an explicitly imagined premise, not a fact inferred from pixels.
No engineering success or completed assignment is established.

entries.alt: A seated musician holds a cello between her knees, with her left fingers on the fingerboard and her right hand guiding a bow across the strings.
entries.caption: A musician gives sustained attention to practice. As a modern application alongside the good-ground image, this scene invites reflection on patient, continuing effort. The connection is perseverance; the picture cannot tell us how difficult the passage is or how many times it has been played.
entries.findings: Right hand rests near bow frog with plausible curved fingers; thumb partially occluded. Bow hair crosses strings between bridge and fingerboard. Left fingertips contact fingerboard plausibly; four strings, bridge, tailpiece and instrument position coherent. Endpin outside frame; no unsupported floating instrument conclusion. Natural face and fabric.
conditions: Do not identify notes, composition, correct fingering or sound quality from unreadable score.
No claim of expert performance or certified technique.

entries.alt: A woman moves papers to a shelf beside an upside-down wooden seat with several upright posts and tools on a workbench.
entries.findings: The wooden object has five long upward posts of comparable leg length, with inconsistent stretcher connections. A separate loose dowel is on the table. The fifth slanting post cannot be confidently resolved as a conventional chair back: no coherent backrest extends beneath the inverted seat. Woman's hands, papers, posture and workshop realism otherwise plausible.
conditions: Revise the furniture to an unmistakable ordinary four-legged stool or chair with coherent underside and stretchers.
For an upside-down chair, show a physically intelligible backrest/support arrangement; simpler four-legged stool would avoid ambiguity.
Preserve paper-clearing action; do not count the current malformed furniture as an accepted repair illustration.
